chunks: Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
If a man comes across a lost sacrificial camel, then he should slaughter it and announce that it is a sacrificial animal.

key_terms.بَدَنَةً: a sacrificial camel offered in the rites of hajj
key_terms.فَلْيَنْحَرْهَا: then he should slaughter it by nahr
key_terms.يُعْلِمُ: he should make known or announce

ai.seo_question: What should be done if someone finds a lost sacrificial camel during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a lost sacrificial camel used in hajj rites. It instructs that when such an animal is found, it should be slaughtered and identified publicly as a sacrificial animal, indicating regulated handling of offerings dedicated for worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3076 - Muawiyah ibn Ammar narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said: "
If a man comes across a lost sacrificial camel, he should slaughter it and announce that it is a sacrificial animal."
